# SignalBench protocol v3 golden records (PROTOCOL_V3_CONTRACT.md section 6).
# Written by can_frame_link_tb (fpga-code can_frame_link_board): every record the
# simulated ESP received, in stream order, as 'R <hex bytes>'; '# ' lines mark scenarios.
# Records: AA CAN (20 B), C5 UART (8), E7 counter (12), 1C I2C (8), 5B SPI (10), D1 DIO (10).
# Config: BUF_AW=10 (1 Ki-sample buffer when 10: phase C overflows it, so some
# records carry dropped=1 and the stream skips the dropped ones), read_len 1024,
# UART0..3 start at 9600/9600/9600/115200 baud.
# phase A: CAN + UART0..3 (probe UART, mode 0) + PROBE2 counter, with link faults injected
